verdict.rationale: There's a Real-time Monitoring Dashboard with live system metrics and browser pool visibility, plus crash-recovery/resume_state features for long-running crawls, which gives some job performance visibility. However there's no evidence of data quality validation checks or alerting/notification mechanisms (email, Slack, webhooks) for failures. missing for 10: data quality validation tooling, alerting/notification system on failure, documented dashboards for quality metrics beyond system resource stats.
